# Ayodhya Interiors & Exterior Studio

> Turnkey architectural interior design, modular kitchens, PVC/WPC wall panels, custom entrance gates, structural glass railings, and commercial fit-outs in Ayodhya and Faizabad, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Core Architectural Disciplines & Hub Pages
- [Home Interior](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/home-interior/): Turnkey living rooms, modular kitchens, wardrobes, TV feature walls, false ceilings, and flooring.
- [Wall Panels & Finishes](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/wall-panels-finishes/): Moisture-proof PVC panels, high-density WPC louvers, fluted slats, and UV marble sheets for damp walls.
- [Gates & Fabrication](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/gates-fabrication/): Heavy-gauge swing, sliding, and fiber laser CNC-cut entrance gates with anti-rust coatings.
- [Railing & Glasses](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/railing-glass/): 12mm toughened safety glass railings, SS 304 balustrades, and laser-cut CNC balcony guards.
- [Exterior Work](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/exterior-work/): Exterior WPC cladding, ACP facade elevations, glass partitions, and slim aluminium door/window systems.
- [Commercial Work](https://ayodhyainteriors.com/services/commercial-work/): Corporate offices, retail showrooms, clinic interiors, and school institutional furniture.
